items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest Questionable on slate; affects Herbert and many projections; game at 4pm ET. Schefter lists Q; practiced some Friday.
items.why: Ribs; multiple DNPs then limited; biggest slate impact.
items.implication: If out, LAC WR volume shifts (e.g. Harris/Johnston); Herbert projections drop.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for other LAC WRs if inactive; monitor for ACTIVE

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL for Sunday (hamstring); Schefter and Rapoport confirm Texans ruled him out.
items.why: Hamstring injury; missed practices; official ruling.
items.implication: HOU WR corps reduced to crumbs; volume to secondary options.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU WRs

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT or DOUBTFUL; Schefter/Rapoport list Flowers doubtful (hamstring, limited/no practice).
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy shifts to Bateman/Walker/others; crumbs overall.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for Rashod Bateman and secondary BAL WRs

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT or DOUBTFUL (knee); Schefter confirms Raiders list him doubtful post-surgery, no practice.
items.implication: LV TE volume to Michael Mayer or others; reduced TE1 floor.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go / said he's playing despite Q (back); ETR lists Q but notes he said playing. Schefter confirms Q listing.
items.why: Back tightness but self-reported good to go; limited practice.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength; Chase/Higgins/Brown usage intact.
items.opportunity: Full snap/route share for CIN pass-catchers

items.text: Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); added to report. Monday night vs Giants; Donald plans to debut. Status watch.
items.why: Hip (possible psoas-related); DNP Friday after clean Week 1.
items.implication: MNF uncertainty; if out, Adams/Whittington elevated but Whittington also dinged.
items.opportunity: Monitor Saturday practice/inactives; Adams routes up if limited

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR; potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Cleared/ready; full practice; AJ Brown high-ankle IR creates need.
items.implication: RBBC with Stevenson; explosive upside in NE offense lacking playmakers.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN after Week 1 inactive (MCL); practiced fully. Impacts Etienne/Miller committee.
items.why: Practiced all week post-sprained MCL caution.
items.implication: Squeezes Etienne/Miller touches; Kamara reclaims lead role.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT (high ankle sprain, IR/return timeline 4-6 weeks); creates NE playmaker vacuum for Henderson et al.
items.implication: NE WR/RB opportunity spike; May targets elsewhere.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining NE skill players including Henderson

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24%+ target share (tied team lead), high util in KC debut; massive season potential if healthy. Vs IND favorable.
items.why: 24% tgt share, 40% routes targeted, high snap/touch share; second-highest career tgt%.
items.implication: RB1 overall range of outcomes; start confidently.
items.opportunity: Passing-game work + carries + RZ; elite util

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF RB share.
items.why: Strong Week 1 usage; Black Q could consolidate further.
items.implication: CMC RB1 locked; monitor Black for any committee drip.

items.text: Dak Prescott on Week 2 LOVE list despite soft Week 1; strong home spot vs WAS (high total, WAS torched in air).
items.why: Home PPG history; WAS secondary vulnerabilities; high implied total.
items.opportunity: Volume to Pickens/Lamb/etc in positive game script

items.text: Devonta Smith back on LOVE list after tough Week 1; aDOT/matchup appeal.
items.implication: WR2/3 start with upside in PHI offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in two-TE or clearout looks

items.text: Ashton Jeanty Util Score 99 (2nd only to Bijan); Bucky Irving career-high 26% tgt share + all RB RZ touches + more routes than Gainwell. Both LOVE/upgrade signals.
items.why: Elite utilization metrics in Week 1; Jeanty passing involvement sustained; Irving receiving/RZ dominance.
items.implication: Start both with confidence; committee fears overstated.
items.opportunity: High target/route/RZ shares driving fantasy output
